question: How many surrounding enclosures may be used when worshipping the attendant group?
premises: The attendant group is the object of worship.
Worship may be performed with one enclosure.
It may alternatively be performed with two or three enclosures.
inference: The attendant group may be worshipped with one, two, or three enclosures.
plain_english: One may worship the group with one enclosure, or with two, or with three enclosures.
